title: My Neighbour Kept Stealing My Wi-Fi 📶
description:
This story may be inspired by real events or jokes, but all names and details are fictional. Any resemblance to real people is coincidental.

#funny #storytime #wifi #shorts
style: 3D animated cartoon movie style, expressive characters with big eyes, vibrant colours, cinematic lighting, vertical composition, highly detailed, no text, no letters, no watermark

scenes.text: My internet was so slow. Then I checked my router. My neighbour was using my Wi-Fi.
scenes.image: a tech-savvy young woman about 27 with glasses and a laptop staring at a router app on her laptop, angry, a neighbour's window visible outside

scenes.text: So I changed my Wi-Fi name to: I can see you, Dave.
scenes.image: a tech-savvy young woman about 27 with glasses and a laptop typing a new network name with an evil smile

scenes.text: The next day, a new network appeared nearby. It was called: Then stop stealing my newspaper.
scenes.image: a phone screen list of Wi-Fi networks with funny names, a tech-savvy young woman about 27 with glasses and a laptop gasping

scenes.text: Okay. It was on. I renamed mine: Your music is too loud.
scenes.image: a tech-savvy young woman about 27 with glasses and a laptop cracking her knuckles at the laptop

scenes.text: His changed to: So is your cat.
scenes.image: a cheeky young man about 25 neighbour peeking from an apartment window grinning while typing on his phone at his window

scenes.text: For a whole week, our Wi-Fi names argued for us. The entire building was reading along.
scenes.image: neighbours in an apartment building all looking at their phones and laughing

scenes.text: Finally, I renamed mine: Free pizza tonight, apartment five.
scenes.image: a tech-savvy young woman about 27 with glasses and a laptop typing with a peace-making smile

scenes.text: That night, Dave knocked with a pizza. Now he pays half my internet. And I still get his newspaper.
scenes.image: a tech-savvy young woman about 27 with glasses and a laptop and a cheeky young man about 25 neighbour peeking from an apartment window sharing pizza and laughing at a doorway, a newspaper under her arm
